question.text: Semiconductors have a conductivity range of <math><mn>1</mn><msup><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow></msup></math> to <math><mn>1</mn><msup><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">h</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> . solution.text: Conductivity range of semiconductors are in the range of   <math><mn>1</mn><msup><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow></msup></math>  to  <math><mn>1</mn><msup><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msup></math>   <math><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">h</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> .
